chunks: And Ḥamzah ibn Ḥumrān narrated through his chain of transmission:

A man came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله with a man beside him, and informed him of a newborn he had. The man’s color changed, so the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said, “What is the matter with you?” He said, “Good.” He said, “Speak.” He said, “I left while the woman was in labor, and I was informed that she had given birth to a girl.”
So the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said to him, “The earth carries her, the sky shades her, and Allah provides for her; and she is a fragrant flower that you smell.”

Then he turned to his companions and said, “Whoever has one daughter is afflicted with care; whoever has two daughters, then seek help from Allah for him; whoever has three daughters, jihad and every hardship are lifted from him; and whoever has four daughters, O servants of Allah, help him; O servants of Allah, lend to him; O servants of Allah, have mercy on him.”

key_terms.أَقْرِضُوهُ: lend to him or support him financially
key_terms.الْجِهَادُ: jihad, here mentioned as being lifted from one with three daughters
key_terms.رَيْحَانَةٌ: a fragrant flower, expressing tenderness and delight

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about having daughters?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a noble Prophetic attitude toward daughters and corrects negative attitudes toward the birth of girls. It presents daughters as recipients of Allah’s sustenance and mercy, and it urges the community to support those raising multiple daughters.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4697 - Hamzah ibn Humran narrated through his chain of transmission that a man came to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) while another man was sitting with Him (sw).

The man informed the Prophet (sw) about the birth of his child, and the color of the man's face changed.
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) asked him: "What is the matter with you?"
The man replied: "It's nothing."
The Prophet (sw) said: "Speak."
The man said: "I left while my wife was in labor, and I was informed that she gave birth to a daughter."

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said to him: "The earth will carry her, the sky will shade her, and Allah (swt) will provide for her. She is a sweet flower that you will smell."

Then the Prophet (sw) turned to his companions and said: "Whoever has one daughter will be burdened with care.
Whoever has two daughters, then seek help from Allah (swt) for him.
Whoever has three daughters, the obligation of jihad and every hardship is lifted from him.
And whoever has four daughters, O servants of Allah (swt), help him! O servants of Allah (swt), support him! O servants of Allah (swt), have mercy on him!"
